title: Abort of an imager paused after transit is not exercised by a test
summary: The flip failure tests inject the PAUSE_AFTER_TRANSIT event; the real Imager Agent is not paused when the flip failure aborts it. The Alert outcome through wait_for_resume is confirmed by code inspection only. Next: pause the real imager after transit (or with PAUSE_WAIT) before failing the flip in the capture test.
